description.zh:
块卷缓存模式，默认值：Cache。取值范围：

- Cache：缓存模式。

- WriteThrough：写透模式。

> 
> -  必须指定该参数。
> -  缓存模式下，读写会优先访问网关本地缓存；写透模式下读写会直接访问云上OSS Bucket，通常情况下缓存模式读写性能更好。
description.en:
The cache mode of the block volume. Default value: Cache. Valid values:

- Cache: cache mode.
- WriteThrough: write-through mode.

> * You must specify this parameter.
> * In cache mode, read and write operations preferentially access the local cache of the gateway. In write-through mode, read and write operations directly access the OSS bucket in the cloud. In most cases, the cache mode provides better read and write performance.

description.zh:
块卷是否启用iSCSI访问的CHAP认证，目前支持CHAP入站验证。

 默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Challenge-Handshake Authentication Protocol (CHAP) for iSCSI access. Inbound CHAP is supported.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
块卷启用iSCSI访问CHAP认证时，入站验证的密码。长度限制12-16个字符，可以包含英文、字母、数字或者符号“!”，“@”，“#”，“$”，“%”，“^”，“&”，“*”。

> 未开启Chap认证时该参数无效。
description.en:
The password for inbound CHAP when CHAP is enabled for the block volume. The password must be 12 to 16 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, or the following special characters: !, @, #, $, %, ^, &, and \*.

> This parameter is invalid when CHAP is disabled.

description.zh:
块卷启用iSCSI访问CHAP认证时，入站验证的用户名。长度限制1~32个字符，包含英文字母、数字。

> 未开启Chap认证时该参数无效。
description.en:
The username for inbound CHAP when CHAP is enabled for the block volume. The username must be 1 to 32 characters in length and can contain letters and digits.

> This parameter is invalid when CHAP is disabled.

description.zh:
块卷存储分配单元。块卷的最小分配单位，为达到最佳的存储效率，建议与应用的存储分配单元一致。单位：Byte。取值范围：

- 8192。

- 16384。

- 32768。

- 65536。

- 131072。

默认值：32768。

> 启用恢复情况下，该参数无效。
description.en:
The storage allocation unit of the block volume. This parameter specifies the minimum allocation unit of the block volume. To achieve optimal storage efficiency, we recommend that you set this parameter to the same value as the storage allocation unit of the application. Unit: bytes. Valid values:

- 8192\.
- 16384\.
- 32768\.
- 65536\.
- 131072\.

Default value: 32768.

> This parameter is invalid when recovery is enabled.

description.zh:
块卷使用的缓存盘内部设备名。可以通过DescribeGatewayCaches接口得到。

> 
> - 当CacheMode为缓存模式时，LocalFilePath必须指定。
> - 当CacheMode为写透模式时，该参数值无效。
description.en:
The internal device name of the cache disk used by the block volume. You can call the DescribeGatewayCaches operation to obtain the name.

> - If CacheMode is set to Cache, you must specify LocalFilePath.
> - If CacheMode is set to WriteThrough, this parameter is invalid.

description.zh: 块卷名称。长度限制1~32个字符，可以包含小写字母，数字，同时必须以小写字母开头。
description.en: The name of the block volume. The name must be 1 to 32 characters in length, start with a lowercase letter, and can contain lowercase letters and digits.

description.zh:
块卷对应的对象存储（OSS）Bucket名称。

> 块卷不支持“回源特性”OSS Bucket。
description.en:
The name of the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket that corresponds to the block volume.

> Block volumes do not support OSS buckets for which the back-to-origin feature is enabled.

description.zh: 块卷对应的对象存储（OSS）Bucket所在地域。
description.en: The region where the OSS bucket that corresponds to the block volume is located.

description.zh:
块卷是否启用SSL访问OSS Bucket。

默认值：true。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable SSL to access the OSS bucket.

Default value: true.

description.zh:
块卷对应的对象存储（OSS）Bucket所在地域节点。

> 区分内网及外网Endpoint，建议如果OSS Bucket和网关处于相同Region则使用内网Endpoint：oss-cn-shanghai-internal.aliyuncs.com。
description.en:
The endpoint of the region where the OSS bucket that corresponds to the block volume is located.

> Differentiate between internal and public endpoints. If the OSS bucket and the gateway are in the same region, we recommend that you use an internal endpoint, such as oss-cn-shanghai-internal.aliyuncs.com.

description.zh:
块卷是否启用恢复。如果启用恢复并且OSS Bucket之前被作为块卷的云存储，那么网关会尝试使用其中的元数据集进行块卷恢复。

默认值：false，即会使用OSS Bucket创建新的块卷。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable recovery for the block volume. If you enable recovery and the specified OSS bucket was previously used as the cloud storage of a block volume, the gateway attempts to recover the block volume using the metadata dataset in the bucket.

The default value is false. This value indicates that a new block volume is created using the OSS bucket.

description.zh:
块卷的容量大小。单位：GB。取值范围：

1~262144。

默认值：100。

> 启用恢复情况下，该参数无效。
description.en:
The size of the block volume. Unit: GB. Valid values:

1 to 262144.

Default value: 100.

> This parameter is invalid when recovery is enabled.
The protocol of the block volume. The only valid value is iSCSI.

descriptions.zh:
使用该接口时，需要注意如下事项：

- 您已经创建部署完成块网关，如果采用缓存模式，需要该网关拥有未被使用的缓存盘；采用写透模式，可无需缓存盘。

- 您拥有对象存储(OSS)的Bucket。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, make sure that the following requirements are met:

- You have created and deployed an iSCSI gateway. If the cache mode is used, the gateway must have an unused cache disk. If the write-through mode is used, no cache disk is required.
- You have an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sgw create-gateway-block-volume --gateway-id gw-000dt67z4ijngqvh1000 --name name --recovery false --volume-protocol iSCSI --size 100 --chunk-size 32768 --cache-mode Cache --chap-enabled false --chap-in-user chapInUser --chap-in-password chapInPassword --oss-bucket-name bucketName --oss-endpoint oss-cn-shanghai-internal.aliyuncs.com --oss-bucket-ssl true --local-file-path /dev/vdb --oss-bucket-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sgw CreateGatewayBlockVolume --region cn-hangzhou --VolumeProtocol iSCSI --OssBucketRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Size 100 --ChapEnabled false --CacheMode Cache --GatewayId 'gw-000dt67z4ijngqvh1000' --OssBucketSsl true --Recovery false --Name name --ChunkSize 32768 --OssEndpoint 'oss-cn-shanghai-internal.aliyuncs.com' --ChapInPassword chapInPassword --OssBucketName bucketName --ChapInUser chapInUser --LocalFilePath '/dev/vdb'
